notes.title: Meet the Cauterizer!
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44045978/945524d2dd4a82d30d9adf6649f1a86b419f3eae.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Feel The Burn! [/h1][p][/p][p]Cauterizers are our newest enemy type, and they can be found in the Arena as of the 0.7.3 update to Transfusion. [/p][p][/p][p]Unlike all the enemies up to this point, which rush and overwhelm you, this fearsome foe will try to keep its distance and throw fireballs from afar![/p][p][/p][p]These fireballs deal a considerable amount of damage, but take note that you're not the only one that can get hurt by them...[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes 0.7.3[/h2][h3]Updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new enemy type - Cauterizers. These enemies will attempt to keep their distance and throw fireballs at the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added graphics settings in settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added “holsters” at the player’s sides to hold weapons when not in use[/p][/*][*][p]Added invisible walls while platforms are raising with new enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy tails now move with ragdoll physics[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Some changes to the save system to track settings separately from game progress[/p][/*][*][p]Movement vignette now accounts for vertical movement in addition to horizontal[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Added a new enemy type - Cauterizers. These enemies will attempt to keep their distance and throw fireballs at the player.
Added graphics settings in settings menu
Added “holsters” at the player’s sides to hold weapons when not in use
Added invisible walls while platforms are raising with new enemies
Enemy tails now move with ragdoll physics

tags.bug: Some changes to the save system to track settings separately from game progress
Movement vignette now accounts for vertical movement in addition to horizontal

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.0 - Achievements!
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added initial set of achievements
[*]Randomized order that platforms lower in Arcade Mode
[*]New effects when unlocking weapons
[*]Slight improvements to tracking weapon velocity
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with hit reactions
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s hand to disappear after picking up a dismembered limb
[*]Other misc code optimizations
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s hand to disappear after picking up a dismembered limb
